caption: The drawing consists of two rectangular objects resembling textile samples, placed one above the other on a plain background. The upper object is rendered in color, showing a piece of beige or light tan fabric with a decorative edge that appears fringed or lace-like on three sides. It features a botanical design with large, stylized flowers in shades of blue and red, connected by brown, curving stems and accompanied by blue-green leaves of various shapes and sizes. The lower object is a black-and-white line drawing of a similar shape and composition, with a similar botanical motif of flowers and leaves connected by thin stems, outlined but without color or shading. The botanical patterns are randomly distributed across the surfaces of both objects. Handwritten text appears beneath the lower object, and there is a small scale annotation near the upper left corner of the colored textile.
title: Crewel Embroidery for Bed Hanging
